sources.title: OpenTimelineIO issue #1985: Clarity requested on Media Reference target_url format
sources.version_or_commit: Opened 2025-12-11; page showed open in 1.0 Release milestone during direct review
sources.locator: Issue description and maintainer reply; open status; conflicting docs/tests, POSIX URL interpretation, Windows-style path uncertainty.
sources.access_utc: 2026-10-12T02:44:31Z (direct page opened; exact fetch time unavailable)
sources.observed_operation: Opened and read the exact official issue. The author reports docs/tests disagree on file:// prefixes and cites Premiere Beta 26.1 exports and DaVinci Resolve 20.2 import behavior; a maintainer describes POSIX examples and explicitly says Windows path behavior is not well recalled.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The reporter's interoperability observation is not an independently reproduced test. Issue remains open. Maintainer says OTIO URL references may be absolute or relative and may use various schemes; a malformed file:// path can be ambiguous. Windows behavior is not resolved in that comment.
sources.applicability: Use an app-defined package-relative path rule and cross-platform moved-package tests; do not treat one interoperable URL spelling as settled across tools.
